results.question: Có những nhân viên bán hàng nào có hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội so với bình quân?
results.sql:
WITH "entity_performance" AS (
  SELECT
    "Sales_Rep_ID" AS "Mã nhân viên bán hàng",
    "Sales_Rep_Name" AS "Tên nhân viên bán hàng",
    SUM(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Tổng giá trị",
    AVG(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Trung bình giá trị",
    COUNT(*) AS "Số dòng"
  FROM "sales_eval_fixture"
  WHERE TO_NUMBER("Value") IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "Sales_Rep_ID", "Sales_Rep_Name"
),
"benchmark" AS (
  SELECT AVG(TO_NUMBER("Tổng giá trị")) AS "Bình quân tổng giá trị"
  FROM "entity_performance"
)
SELECT
  "entity_performance"."Mã nhân viên bán hàng",
  "entity_performance"."Tên nhân viên bán hàng",
  "entity_performance"."Tổng giá trị",
  "entity_performance"."Trung bình giá trị",
  "entity_performance"."Số dòng",
  "benchmark"."Bình quân tổng giá trị",
  "entity_performance"."Tổng giá trị" - "benchmark"."Bình quân tổng giá trị" AS "Chênh lệch so với bình quân",
  ROUND(("entity_performance"."Tổng giá trị" / NULLIF("benchmark"."Bình quân tổng giá trị", 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS "Tỷ lệ vượt bình quân (%)"
FROM "entity_performance"
CROSS JOIN "benchmark"
WHERE "entity_performance"."Tổng giá trị" > "benchmark"."Bình quân tổng giá trị"
ORDER BY "entity_performance"."Tổng giá trị" DESC;
columns: Chênh lệch so với bình quân

results.question: Which sales representatives are above the average sales performance?
results.sql:
WITH "entity_performance" AS (
  SELECT
    "Sales_Rep_ID" AS "Sales Rep ID",
    "Sales_Rep_Name" AS "Sales Rep Name",
    SUM(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Total Value",
    AVG(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Average Value",
    COUNT(*) AS "Record Count"
  FROM "sales_eval_fixture"
  WHERE TO_NUMBER("Value") IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "Sales_Rep_ID", "Sales_Rep_Name"
),
"benchmark" AS (
  SELECT AVG(TO_NUMBER("Total Value")) AS "Average Total Value"
  FROM "entity_performance"
)
SELECT
  "entity_performance"."Sales Rep ID",
  "entity_performance"."Sales Rep Name",
  "entity_performance"."Total Value",
  "entity_performance"."Average Value",
  "entity_performance"."Record Count",
  "benchmark"."Average Total Value",
  "entity_performance"."Total Value" - "benchmark"."Average Total Value" AS "Difference Above Average",
  ROUND(("entity_performance"."Total Value" / NULLIF("benchmark"."Average Total Value", 0) - 1) * 100, 2) AS "Above Average Rate (%)"
FROM "entity_performance"
CROSS JOIN "benchmark"
WHERE "entity_performance"."Total Value" > "benchmark"."Average Total Value"
ORDER BY "entity_performance"."Total Value" DESC;

results.question: Làm thế nào để phân loại Sales_Rep_ID thành các nhóm dựa trên hiệu suất bán hàng?
results.sql:
WITH "entity_performance" AS (
  SELECT
    "Sales_Rep_ID" AS "Mã nhân viên bán hàng",
    "Sales_Rep_Name" AS "Tên nhân viên bán hàng",
    SUM(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Tổng giá trị",
    AVG(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Trung bình giá trị",
    COUNT(*) AS "Số dòng"
  FROM "sales_eval_fixture"
  WHERE TO_NUMBER("Value") IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "Sales_Rep_ID", "Sales_Rep_Name"
),
"ranked" AS (
  SELECT
    "entity_performance".*,
    NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY "Tổng giá trị" DESC) AS "_performance_bucket"
  FROM "entity_performance"
)
SELECT
  "ranked"."Mã nhân viên bán hàng",
  "ranked"."Tên nhân viên bán hàng",
  "ranked"."Tổng giá trị",
  "ranked"."Trung bình giá trị",
  "ranked"."Số dòng",
  CASE "_performance_bucket" WHEN 1 THEN 'Cao' WHEN 2 THEN 'Trung bình' ELSE 'Thấp' END AS "Nhóm hiệu suất"
FROM "ranked"
ORDER BY "ranked"."Tổng giá trị" DESC;

results.question: Classify sales reps into performance groups based on sales value
results.sql:
WITH "entity_performance" AS (
  SELECT
    "Sales_Rep_ID" AS "Sales Rep ID",
    "Sales_Rep_Name" AS "Sales Rep Name",
    SUM(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Total Value",
    AVG(TO_NUMBER("Value")) AS "Average Value",
    COUNT(*) AS "Record Count"
  FROM "sales_eval_fixture"
  WHERE TO_NUMBER("Value") IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "Sales_Rep_ID", "Sales_Rep_Name"
),
"ranked" AS (
  SELECT
    "entity_performance".*,
    NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY "Total Value" DESC) AS "_performance_bucket"
  FROM "entity_performance"
)
SELECT
  "ranked"."Sales Rep ID",
  "ranked"."Sales Rep Name",
  "ranked"."Total Value",
  "ranked"."Average Value",
  "ranked"."Record Count",
  CASE "_performance_bucket" WHEN 1 THEN 'High' WHEN 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS "Performance Group"
FROM "ranked"
ORDER BY "ranked"."Total Value" DESC;
